report_title: PMTL_VN Admin Architecture Alignment Gap Analysis

phase_0_shell_and_auth_safe_data.description: Shell, query client, error handling, read-only foundation

missing: guestbook: folder missing (router references it but no feature folder)

completed: users (queries.ts + mutations.ts — but file location is /features/users not /features/users-admin)
sessions (queries.ts + mutations.ts — but file location is /features/sessions not /features/sessions-admin)
phase_4_identity_support_wisdom_contact.naming_mismatch: folders use short names instead of 'admin' suffix per APPS_ADMIN_SCAFFOLD_BACKLOG.md

critical_gaps.evidence: postKeys uses 'lists()' (plural) while charityKeys/volunteerKeys skip intermediate list() step. Feature folders like dharma-compliance, altar-management, life-liberation use non-admin-prefixed keys (e.g., 'charities' instead of 'admin-charities')
critical_gaps.spec_reference: ADMIN_FEATURE_QUERY_PLAN.md requires all features to use 'admin-' prefix in root key
critical_gaps.recommended_fix: Audit all /features/*/queries.ts — ensure ALL query keys follow pattern ['admin-<feature>'] as root; standardize lists()/details() intermediate functions across all features

critical_gaps.item: Missing feature folders vs. router expectations
critical_gaps.evidence: Router references /admin/noi-dung/kinh-bai-tap (daily-practice-admin), /admin/noi-dung/ngoi-nha-nho (little-house-admin), /admin/noi-dung/phong-sanh (life-release-admin), /admin/noi-dung/tau-lieu (media-library-admin), /admin/noi-dung/thu-vien (wisdom-baihoa for media) and others, but feature folders are entirely missing
critical_gaps.recommended_fix: Create missing feature folders with queries.ts + mutations.ts for each workspace; use ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md and ADMIN_FEATURE_QUERY_PLAN.md as templates

critical_gaps.item: Invalidation doesn't respect role narrowing per ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md
critical_gaps.evidence: Mutations invalidate dashboard globally ('dashboardKeys.all') without checking which dashboard panel was actually affected. Per ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md, dashboard should only invalidate specific aggregates (systemSummary, pendingModeration, contentOpsSummary, etc.) when relevant mutation occurs
critical_gaps.spec_reference: ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md line 76-92: Dashboard widget dependency shortcut
critical_gaps.recommended_fix: Create granular dashboard invalidation helpers: invalidateDashboardContentOps(), invalidateDashboardPendingModeration(), etc. Update all mutations to call only relevant helpers

critical_gaps.evidence: Posts publish mutation invalidates only admin keys + dashboardKeys.all. Per spec, publish/unpublish must also trigger public cache invalidation owner (e.g., revalidateTag() or webhook to platform/cache module)
critical_gaps.spec_reference: ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md lines 99, 101-105; ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md section 'Cross-module invalidation edge rules'
critical_gaps.recommended_fix: Add onSuccess callback to publish/unpublish mutations that triggers platform cache invalidation owner (e.g., notify platform/cache via API or event bus)

critical_gaps.evidence: Design specifies /features/users-admin, /features/sessions-admin, /features/daily-practice-admin, but codebase uses /features/users, /features/sessions, /features/daily-recitation. Feature folders like dharma-compliance, life-liberation, sacred-forms, altar-management, little-house are non-canonical.
critical_gaps.recommended_fix: Consolidate naming: rename /features/users → /features/users-admin, /features/sessions → /features/sessions-admin, etc. Keep consistent -admin suffix for clarity that these are admin-only features

critical_gaps.evidence: Some features like altar-management use raw Record<string, unknown> for filters instead of typed filter interfaces. This can cause cache misses if filter object is regenerated with same values.
critical_gaps.spec_reference: APPS_ADMIN_SCAFFOLD_BACKLOG.md line 230: 'filter object phải stable và serialize được'
critical_gaps.recommended_fix: Define explicit Filter interfaces for all list queries (e.g., PostListFilters already done in content/queries.ts); validate all filters are serializable and stable

critical_gaps.item: Role narrowing not enforced at component level
critical_gaps.evidence: Admin pages render all buttons but design requires backend policy projection for sensitive actions. Mutations like updateFeatureFlag(), blockUser(), changeRole() may execute without explicit role gate at UI.
critical_gaps.spec_reference: ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md lines 26-57: Role narrowing inside admin surfaces
critical_gaps.recommended_fix: Add backend policy projection to all sensitive mutations (result: { allowed: boolean, reason?: string }); conditionally render buttons based on policy, not just page route gate

critical_gaps.item: Broad dashboard invalidation on every mutation
critical_gaps.evidence: Most mutations invalidate dashboardKeys.all, which prevents granular re-render optimization
critical_gaps.recommended_fix: Implement dashboard widget dependency map; mutations only invalidate dashboard when that widget is actually affected

module_maturity.admin_justification: Core shell + query infra complete. Phase 0-1 largely done (posts, dashboard, auth-safe pages). Phase 2-4 missing ~40% of expected workspaces (daily-practice, little-house, life-release, media-library, guestbook, search-admin). Feature folder naming deviated from design. Query key consistency issues. Cross-module invalidation incomplete.
module_maturity.api_justification: Modules exist (content, community, moderation, calendar, etc.); routes likely defined per API_ROUTE_INVENTORY.md. Admin routes assumed correct by design. DTO contracts and error envelopes in place. Missing evidence of full admin role narrowing enforcement at endpoint level.
module_maturity.web_justification: Not the focus of this analysis, but referenced design suggests public surface exists. Web is typically more complete than admin. No critical alignment issues detected in cross-module invalidation notes.

missing_from_design_canon.note: These folders exist in apps/admin but are NOT in APPS_ADMIN_SCAFFOLD_BACKLOG.md Wave 0-4. Either: (1) they are new domains post-design, (2) they belong to different module or (3) they should be removed. Clarify ownership and add to design docs if legitimate.

ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md references /admin/cong-dong/so-luu-niem (guestbook), but folder doesn't exist. Router line 79-80 imports from @/features/workspaces/module-pages which suggests it's bundled elsewhere.
Design expects /features/posts but code uses /features/content with posts inside. This works but deviates from APPS_ADMIN_SCAFFOLD_BACKLOG.md naming.

api_contract_risks.evidence: Some mutations use /content/posts (no /admin prefix), others use /admin/content/guides. Design spec says API group can be English under /api/admin/* but admin page routes must use Vietnamese.
api_contract_risks.fix: Verify all admin mutations hit /api/admin/* routes (not /api/content/*); ensure API contract matches ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md mapping table

api_contract_risks.risk: Missing API routes for workspace features
api_contract_risks.evidence: daily-practice-admin, little-house-admin, life-release-admin have no queries.ts/mutations.ts, so API route inventory completeness is untested
api_contract_risks.fix: Cross-check design/04-execution-overlay/api/API_ROUTE_INVENTORY.md for these workspace routes; confirm they exist and scaffold queries.ts/mutations.ts

query_client_config_status.details: Query client setup complete; invalidate.ts has basic helpers (invalidateFamily, invalidateExact, invalidateDashboard). Missing: granular invalidation helpers for dashboard widget deps, cross-module cache owner integration

next_actions.description: Audit all /features/*/queries.ts files. Ensure all root keys follow ['admin-<feature>'] pattern per design spec. Update non-canonical keys (charities → admin-charities, altar-management → admin-altar-management, etc.). Establish list()/detail()/aux pattern consistently.

Create missing feature folders per APPS_ADMIN_SCAFFOLD_BACKLOG.md Wave 1: daily-practice-admin, little-house-admin, life-release-admin, media-library-admin, beginner-guides (mutations.ts only). Use ADMIN_FEATURE_QUERY_PLAN.md rows 5-8 as templates.

Create invalidate.ts helpers for each dashboard widget: invalidateDashboardContentOps(), invalidateDashboardPendingModeration(), invalidateDashboardSearchOps(), etc. Update all mutations to call only relevant helpers instead of invalidateDashboard().
next_actions.affected_files: apps/admin/src/lib/query/invalidate.ts, apps/admin/src/features/*/mutations.ts (all files with dashboard invalidation)

next_actions.action: Add cross-module cache invalidation for publish/unpublish
next_actions.description: For content publish mutations (posts, guides, downloads, wisdom entries, etc.), add onSuccess callback that notifies public cache owner. Implement as API call to trigger revalidateTag() or event bus publish. Coordinate with platform/cache module.

next_actions.action: Enforce role narrowing at component level
next_actions.description: Add backend policy projection to all sensitive mutation responses (e.g., { allowed: boolean, reason?: string }). Conditionally render action buttons based on policy. Document which actions require which roles per ADMIN_PAGE_API_MAPPING.md table.

Optionally: rename /features/users → /features/users-admin, /features/sessions → /features/sessions-admin for consistency with design naming convention. This is lower priority if codebase is already stable and tests pass.

dharma-compliance, life-liberation, sacred-forms, altar-management, daily-recitation do not appear in APPS_ADMIN_SCAFFOLD_BACKLOG.md. Confirm these are intentional new domains and update design docs accordingly, OR remove them if they are exploratory/unvetted.
next_actions.affected_files: design/04-execution-overlay/admin/ (if confirmed legitimate), or apps/admin/src/features/ (if to be archived)

next_actions.description: Cross-reference all mutations in apps/admin/src/features/*/mutations.ts against design/04-execution-overlay/api/API_ROUTE_INVENTORY.md. Confirm endpoint paths match canonical API routes. Validate request/response DTOs are documented in API_DTO_SHAPE_PLAN.md.

breakdown.architecture_foundation: 95% (Vite + React SPA, query client, API contracts OK)
breakdown.query_layer: 70% (query key factories mostly correct, but naming inconsistencies and missing granular invalidation)
breakdown.mutation_layer: 65% (mutations scaffolded but missing cross-module invalidation, role narrowing projection, and granular dashboard updates)
breakdown.feature_coverage: 65% (Phase 0-2 mostly done, Phase 3-4 partially done, ~40% of expected workspaces still missing)
breakdown.module_boundaries: 70% (mostly clean, but some non-canonical features polluting admin scope)

critical_path: 1. Fix query key naming consistency (blocks all other validation)
2. Scaffold missing workspace features (blocks Phase completion)
4. Add cross-module cache integration (blocks public surface correctness)
summary.confidence: HIGH — analysis based on design docs (authoritative), code inspection (definitive), and patterns recognized across multiple feature files
